'''Virtual Block 6''' is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion (Reflections IV era). These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The official sheets are titled Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV,<ref name="vb6pdf1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf], Star Wars CCG Players Committee (official text 4 September 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Virtual Block 6: Domain Of Evil,<ref name="vb6pdf2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf VirtualBlock6_2.pdf], Star Wars CCG Players Committee (official text 7 December 2009). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> and Virtual Block 6: Mercenaries.<ref name="vb6pdf3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf VirtualBlock6_3.pdf], Star Wars CCG Players Committee (official text 15 March 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee issued the cards as printed slips: print the sheet, cut out the area beneath the card title, and sleeve the cutout with the original card.

The hub Date is '''September 2009''' for the Reflections IV core, announced with the 16 September 2009 Players Committee homepage news (Reflections IV + virtual-set realignment).<ref name="reorg2009">https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/</ref> Later Block 6 subsets: Virtual Set 6.2 Domain of Evil (7 December 2009; tournament legal 21 December 2009); Virtual Set 6.3 Mercenaries (15 March 2010).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.

[[The Circle Is Now Complete]] or [[Vader's Obsession]] may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability.
